accepted.reentrancy-balance:PYDFunder: The swap target is an owner-set swapper (trusted config, like the baselined funding source); nonReentrant blocks re-entry into topUp (the only USDC spender); the swap OUTPUT is verified by balance delta (the return value is advisory); the USDC allowance is revoked immediately after the swap. Slither rates reentrancy-balance Low impact; the monitor's blanket reentrancy-family rule over-elevates it. Re-verified 2026-09-20.
accepted.incorrect-equality:SUSD3Strategy: Intentional zero-guards: completeInbound `received == 0`, pushIdle `amount == 0`, and _doHarvest `sweep == 0` (no realized yield to sweep). The zero branches move no value; same guarded pattern as DNCoreStrategy/HLEarnStrategy/PTSleeveStrategy. Pre-existed the 2026-10-05 yield/principal port (the port added only the _doHarvest guard). Added 2026-10-05 (sUSD3 attribution, kanban t_4e477d28).
accepted.unindexed-event-address:SUSD3Strategy: Informational: ReturnHookUnavailable(vault, amount) is a best-effort F-5 notification event, kept identical to PTSleeveStrategy's (the backward-safe pattern the round-2 reviewer required). No on-chain logic reads it as a filter key. Added 2026-10-05 (sUSD3 attribution, kanban t_4e477d28).
accepted.reentrancy-benign:SUSD3Strategy: All mutating entry points (deployToEth/completeInbound/ackArrival/syncEthValue/pushIdle/recall) are nonReentrant-guarded; the external calls are the CCTP transmitter (which mints only to this contract) and the vault return hook. Slither cannot model the guard. Same class already accepted for DeltaNeutralStrategy/ProYieldVault/PTSleeveStrategy. Flagged 2026-10-05 while porting the yield/principal split (kanban t_4e477d28).
accepted.reentrancy-balance:SUSD3Strategy: completeInbound measures the inbound mint as a balance delta after receiveMessage. The CCTP transmitter mints only to this contract (mintRecipient fixed in our return transfers) and completeInbound is nonReentrant, so the 'stale balance' path is not reachable; the balance read is the intended measurement. Slither rates it High impact but cannot model the guard/recipient. Mirrors PTSleeveStrategy. Flagged 2026-10-05 (kanban t_4e477d28).
accepted.reentrancy-no-eth:SUSD3Strategy: All mutating entry points are nonReentrant-guarded; the flagged call is the immutable CCTP messenger in deployToEth, which burns to the fixed ethExecutor (the keeper cannot redirect a cent). Slither cannot model the guard. Same class already accepted for DeltaNeutralStrategy. Flagged 2026-10-05 (kanban t_4e477d28).
accepted.incorrect-equality:PTSleeveStrategy: Intentional zero-guard: _doHarvest early-returns on `sweep == 0` (no realized yield to sweep). Same guarded pattern as DNCoreStrategy/HLEarnStrategy; no value moves on the zero branch. Added 2026-10-05 (PT remediation, kanban t_698f42c2).
accepted.unindexed-event-address:PTSleeveStrategy: Informational: ReturnHookUnavailable(vault, amount) is a best-effort F-5 notification event, kept identical to SUSD3Strategy's (the backward-safe pattern the round-2 reviewer required).
